message.content: Now let me look at the build script and the fuzzer to understand how the target is built and run:

content:
Here's the result of running `cat -n` on /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/build.sh:
     1	mkdir json-c-build
     2	cd json-c-build
     3	cmake -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF ..
     4	make -j$(nproc)
     5	cd ..
     6	cp $SRC/*.dict $OUT/
     7	for f in $SRC/*_fuzzer.cc; do
     8	    fuzzer=$(basename "$f" _fuzzer.cc)
     9	    $CXX $CXXFLAGS -std=c++11 -I$SRC/json-c -I$SRC/json-c/json-c-build         $SRC/${fuzzer}_fuzzer.cc -o $OUT/${fuzzer}_fuzzer          $LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE $SRC/json-c/json-c-build/libjson-c.a
    10	done
    11
